summary:
Mars Trail Sentinel is an interactive Mars exploration and mission-planning platform developed by Team HACKTECH. It helps visualize Martian terrain, identify potential hazards, and support safer planning of astronaut and rover exploration routes.

The platform focuses on the Lower Mount Sharp region of Gale Crater, including the Boxwork Ridge area. It brings together terrain visualization, geological context, and mission-planning concepts in an interactive mapping experience. By helping users understand slopes, surface features, obstacles, and scientifically interesting locations, Mars Trail Sentinel demonstrates how planetary data can support informed exploration decisions.

Our goal is to make complex Mars surface information easier to explore and understand while highlighting the importance of astronaut safety, scientific discovery, and responsible route planning for future human missions to Mars.
details:
Mars Trail Sentinel is an interactive web-based Mars exploration and mission-planning application created by Team HACKTECH. The project focuses on the Lower Mount Sharp region of Gale Crater, particularly the Boxwork Ridge area, to demonstrate how planetary mapping and terrain information can support future Mars surface exploration.

The application provides an interactive map-based interface for exploring Martian surface features and understanding the challenges involved in planning rover and astronaut traverses. It is designed around the idea of combining different types of planetary information, including terrain, geological features, imagery, and potential hazards, into one accessible exploration environment.

The project aims to help users identify areas of scientific interest, understand terrain-related risks, and visualize possible exploration routes. Its intended impact is to make Mars exploration information easier to interpret and demonstrate how data-driven planning can contribute to safer and more effective future missions.

The project uses web technologies including React, TypeScript, Vite, and MapLibre for the application interface and mapping experience. Browser-based storage technologies such as IndexedDB support local data handling and offline-oriented functionality. Supabase is included in the project architecture for backend services.

The creative aspect of Mars Trail Sentinel is its focus on connecting planetary exploration with practical mission-planning needs. Instead of treating Mars imagery as isolated pictures, the project presents an exploration-oriented interface that encourages users to consider terrain, scientific value, and astronaut safety together.

The team considered usability, accessibility of planetary information, terrain awareness, mission-planning challenges, and the importance of reliable data when designing the project.
